messages:
mira: quick report from model onboarding (magna-14B quant experiments): reproducible divergence on int4 when resuming long-prefix streaming around ~4k tokens.
mira: fp16 and int8 (non-packed) match reference; int4 packed path shows token substitutions after resume.
mira: repro: `./resume_longprefix --ckpt v1.2 --streaming --append 600` using packed-pipeline v2.
leo_infra: did you use the new tile-stride calc in v2? we adjusted it to optimize memory layout last sprint.
mira: yes v2 uses STRIDE_OPT=1. disabling it moves onset later but doesn't eliminate.
devon_research: hypothesis: packed int4 rounding + stride mapping causes buffer slots to alias across adjacent positions when seq_len aligns with tile boundaries. small numeric/stride mismatch could cause identical KV hashes for two consecutive positions then a jump.
oncall-bot: please upload KV checksums for positions 4094..4100 and include kernel version.
mira: checksums pasted: `int4@4096: sha1=a9f1...`, `int4@4097: sha1=a9f1...`, `int4@4098: sha1=ce02...` (4096/4097 identical).
leo_infra: that pattern strongly suggests an off-by-one in the circular buffer index calc when (seq_len % tile_size) == 0. try running with `--tile-size 128 --debug-stream` and env `STREAM_TILE_STRIDE=manual`.
devon_research: also try kernel v1.1 (packed-v1) vs v1.0 to see if regression introduced between them. measure token-level divergence curve across quant levels.
oncall-bot: queued dedicated job on cluster/dedicated-magna id=998111222 for bisect.
mira: local experiment: tile-size 128 => no repro; 256 => repro at ~4097. v1.0 packed seems clean.
leo_infra: i'm opening a kernel-bisect ticket and will prepare a revert branch for the stride tweak if confirmed.
devon_research: short-term mitigation: add a resume-time checksum check — if KV mismatch on resume, rehydrate next 64 tokens in fp16 then switch back to quant-packed. i'll draft eval to quantify user-facing risk.
oncall-bot: job 998111222 finished: fp16 ok; int4 packed-v2 repro; artifacts `/artifacts/998111222/stream-debug.log`.
mira: thanks; next steps: leo bisect/revert candidate, devon eval and mitigation PR, add alerting for checksum divergence. I'll add a block in the bring-up checklist for packed-v2 until fix. :thumbsup:
